process_validity.grounds: Stage 1 founder-led incubation, declared in CHARTER.md §7. Participant set = founder only. The registry_update clock (3-7 days from 2026-07-25) made this decidable 2026-07-28 through 2026-08-01; it was recorded 2026-08-05 — late, disclosed here as a process fact rather than backdated. One self-raised objection (objections/objection-001.md, founder-only seed registry) answered and carried on the record. project_result.ballots is 0 because both ballot files are the founder's individual A/B pair; no project cast a ballot, and counting the pair here would inflate exactly the number this registry refuses to inflate.
limitations_disclosed: decision recorded after its due window
